as-0C0S.title: Google car: silver-grey truck front, side mirrors
as-0C0S.summary: You see the front of a silver-grey truck with its side mirrors. It covers two islands joined by a bridge.

as-H73S.title: Airport: small concrete runway, orange straps
as-H73S.summary: A small airport with a concrete runway and many palms across it. The car has two orange straps on its roof.

as-OwzU.title: Landscape: green mountains, palms, tin roofs
as-OwzU.summary: Green tropical mountains with many palm trees. Small roads are often concrete, houses are one-storey boxes, and plain metal sheet roofs are common.

as-UnVR.title: Google car: glossy black truck front
as-UnVR.summary: Like the silver-grey truck but glossy black, with side mirrors visible. It covers the easternmost covered island.

as-Ve3W.title: Coverage: Pacific islands counted as the US
as-Ve3W.summary: A group of Pacific islands east of Fiji. It is a US territory, so for country streaks it counts as the US.

as-W6tU.title: Bridge: single lane, thin wire guardrail
as-W6tU.summary: A one-lane bridge between two islands with a thin wire guardrail, and an island on each side.

as-lm-437532.title: Road: urban north-south road, mountain north
as-lm-437532.summary: Urban road running north-south, driving north, with a mountain ahead, double yellow lines and a power line to the east. Panning exactly north should show that mountain.

as-lm-437533.title: Town: coast to the north, mountains elsewhere
as-lm-437533.summary: A small town on the easternmost island, so the glossy black truck. The sea lies to the north and mountains surround it everywhere else.

as-lm-437534.title: Road: north coast next to the bridge, paved
as-lm-437534.summary: Two covered roads with a north coast lie either side of the bridge. The west one has concrete pavement; the east one is unpaved.

as-lm-441695.title: Road: south coast, driving west
as-lm-441695.summary: A long road with the sea to the south, driving west. Pan to the back of the truck and the water is on your right. One exception near a beach resort.

as-lm-441696.title: Road: odd angle, mountains north, summit west
as-lm-441696.summary: A main-road stretch crossing a district border, driving east at a distinctive angle with mountains north and often a unique summit in the west. West part is overcast, east part sunny.

as-lm-441698.title: Landscape: very urban, harbour in view
as-lm-441698.summary: Roads around a harbour are the most urban in the territory, and you can often see the water between buildings.

as-lm-441699.title: Road: the straightest road, very flat
as-lm-441699.summary: A section of Route 014 that is by far the straightest covered road on the main island. Check the road angle. Looks varied but is very flat.

as-lm-441700.title: Roadside: airport fences
as-lm-441700.summary: Fences surround the airport along the road. The main island has only one airstrip, so this is an easy pin with its truck.

as-lm-441701.title: Road: south coast, driving east
as-lm-441701.summary: A road with the sea to the south, driving east. Pan to the back of the truck and the water is on your left. A tiny part of the other south-coast road also drives east, which can trick you.

as-lm-688887.title: Road: plain sand road, no grass strip
as-lm-688887.summary: Starting just north of the town entrance until the southernmost house west of the road, the road is plain sand with no grass strip in the middle. Only road like it on the two islands with this car.

as-lm-688888.title: Beach: sea to the south-east, three peaks
as-lm-688888.summary: Walker coverage on a beach with the coast to the south-east and three distinct peaks in the north-east.

as-lm-688889.title: Bay: opens to the north-east
as-lm-688889.summary: The only covered bay opening to the north-east. Another bay opens north-west, and a third opens due north.

as-lm-688890.title: Town: west coast, fully paved, no mountain north
as-lm-688890.summary: A town with a west coast. Unlike the neighbouring island's town it is entirely paved, and there is no mountain to the north.

as-lm-688891.title: Road: concrete road with no coast, far east
as-lm-688891.summary: On the main island, a concrete road with no coast in view means the far east, between two villages near a school.

as-lm-688892.title: Bay: opens due north
as-lm-688892.summary: The only covered bay opening straight north. Another opens north-west and a third north-east.

as-lm-688893.title: Road: east-west asphalt, far west end
as-lm-688893.summary: A long east-west road on the easternmost island is hard to line up. Heading east-west on asphalt puts you at its far western end.

as-lm-688894.title: Road: concrete, overgrown, no guardrail
as-lm-688894.summary: On the long east-west road, concrete, plenty of overgrowth towards the coast and no guardrail means the western part, south of a smooth coastal bump west of the river.

as-lm-688895.title: Road: concrete, overgrown, power line
as-lm-688895.summary: On the long east-west road, concrete, overgrowth towards the coast and a visible power line mean the stretch just west of the river that runs south-west to north-east.

as-lm-688896.title: Road: concrete, coconut palms, power line
as-lm-688896.summary: On the long east-west road, concrete with lots of coconut palms puts you in the middle, east of the river. Just east of the river: palms in the distance, a power line and a guardrail.

as-lm-688897.title: Road: concrete, coconuts, power line, no guardrail
as-lm-688897.summary: On the long east-west road, concrete with many coconut palms, a power line but no guardrail puts you east of the river and west of the small side road.

as-lm-688898.title: Road: concrete, coconuts, no power line
as-lm-688898.summary: On the long east-west road, concrete and many coconut palms, but no power line, means the short stretch just east of the small side road.

as-lm-688899.title: Road: concrete, open coast north, guardrail
as-lm-688899.summary: On the long east-west road, concrete with the sea open to the north means the easternmost part. The western half of this stretch has a guardrail.

as-lm-688901.title: Landscape: two small peaks reaching into the sea
as-lm-688901.summary: Two little peaks sticking out into the ocean, known as Camel Rock. It is marked as a point of interest on Google Maps.

as-lm-688902.title: Road: concrete, overgrown, guardrail
as-lm-688902.summary: On the long east-west road, concrete, overgrowth towards the coast and a guardrail but no power line means the stretch west of the river.

as-lm-688903.title: Coast: sea to the east, nothing else in view
as-lm-688903.summary: The only place on the main island where the coast is to the east without other parts of the island visible. A small island is often visible to the south-east.

as-lm-688904.title: Bay: opens to the north-west
as-lm-688904.summary: The only covered bay opening to the north-west. Another bay opens due north, and a third opens north-east.

as-lm-688905.title: Coverage: boat camera between islands
as-lm-688905.summary: This is the only ferry coverage in the territory. If you are on a boat between two islands, you are here.

as-pQyl.title: Google car: rusted black truck bed
as-pQyl.summary: A slightly rusted black truck bed is visible. It is the most common car, because the main island has the most coverage.
